title: history of the olympics, i guess

voice.note: the original was recorded in an expressive voice that holds spelled-out vowels and reads [deadpan] tags in voice_text, sped to about 245 wpm, and imported with import_voice.py. With narrate.py the free voice reads each held word plainly and timeline.py stretches it (the "hold" marks).

lines.say: nineteen oh four. the olympic marathon. the winner's trainers feed him rat poison. during the race.
on purpose. it's supposed to help.
lines.voice_text: [deadpan] on purpose. it's supposed to help.

lines.say: ok, from the start. greece, seven seventy six b c.
the first olympics is one race. about two hundred meters.
you run it naaaked. covered in olive oil.
first prize: a hat made of leaves. second prize: nothiiing.
this goes on for over a thousand years, until a roman emperor bans it.
about fifteen hundred years later, in eighteen ninety six, athens brings it back.
the marathon is won by a guy who delivers water for a living.
the king offers him a gift. he asks for a cart. for the water.
nineteen hundred, paris. the games last five months. some winners never find out they were at the olympics.
nineteen oh four. back to that marathon.
one guy rides part of it in a car, and crosses the line first.
another eats rotten apples, takes a naaaaap, and still comes fourth.
tug of war is an olympic sport. for twenty years.
so is art. you can win gold for a painting.
nineteen twenty. a seventy two year old wins silver. in shooting.
twenty twenty four. breakdancing is in. twenty twenty eight: it's ouuut.
so, the podium for weirdest olympian. bronze: the nap guy. silver: the seventy two year old.
and gold goes toooo...
